fieldData.acrm---key-feature-sub-heading: Each one answers a question your therapist would otherwise ask with the client already on the table.
fieldData.acrm---integration-feature-4:
Each signed form takes the next 15-minute chair slot

On the Globex wellness day, employees scan a QR code at the break room door and answer three screening questions on their phones. Each signed form takes the next open 15-minute slot. Hana Kim works down the list on a tablet, with each person's areas to avoid beside their name.

acrm---key-feature-4-image.alt: An employee signs a chair massage intake on a phone after three screening questions and takes the next open 15-minute slot, which appears on the therapist's tablet list with the areas to avoid.
